newsitem.title: USA: DII buys IBM facility for $47 mln.
newsitem.headline: DII buys IBM facility for $47 mln.

text.p: The DII Group, Inc said Tuesday that its Multilayer Technology Inc subsidiary has signed a definitive agreement to acquire IBM Corp's high volume printed circuit board fabrication facility in Austin, Texas, inlcuding certain licenses, for $47 million.

The company said that the transaction, combined with its other business activities, should not cause any change to the current First Call earnings estimates of $1.54 per share for the second half of 1997.

It also said that said the transaction should provide more than $80 million of revenues in 1998 and be accretive to its 1998 earnings per share, adding about $0.15 to $0.20 to the First Call estimate of $3.31.
Estimates are before a 2-for-1 stock split payable September 2.
DII said the acquisition is expected to be completed within two weeks, subject to regulatory and other customary closing conditions, and will be funded through its line-of- credit.
The company said that it will provide printed circuit boards to IBM's PC Company and RS/6000 Division under a three year supply agreement.
